data.title: 山田杏奈 · 拍摄休息室大号卫衣的大长腿瘫坐
data.description: 摄影工作结束，杏奈换上宽松连帽卫衣和牛仔短裤，坐进休息室的皮沙发里。她把扎发的发圈取下放在靠垫旁，黑发散到肩上；看到你拿出软糖，立刻抬起头，从宽袖口里伸出一根手指指向糖袋，疲惫的脸也跟着亮了起来。
data.location: 摄影棚后台休息区皮沙发
data.action: 散发坐在摄影休息室沙发上，抬头望向软糖袋，伸手指示自己也想尝一颗。
data.mood: 大型犬撒娇、惊人大长腿
data.promptProse: Yamada is seated deep in the leather dressing-room sofa in her oversized charcoal hoodie and denim shorts, long black hair loose around her shoulders. A short-haired man in a faded blue denim jacket stands beside the sofa and extends a clear bag of gummies from his hand. She looks up from her seat and points one finger toward the offered bag while her hair tie rests on the cushion.
